original_value: In this work, we apply the local Wendland radial basis function (RBF) for solving the time-dependent multi dimensional option pricing nonlinear PDEs. Firstly, cross derivative terms of the PDE are removed with a change of spatial variables based in LDLT factorization of the diffusion matrix. Then, it is discussed that the valuation of a multi-asset option up to 4D can be computed using a modified shape parameter algorithm. In fact, several experiments containing of three and four assets are worked out showing that the results of the presented method are in good agreement with the literature and could be much more accurate once the shape parameter is chosen carefully.

result.paraphrase: This work uses a local Wendland radial basis function (RBF) to solve time-dependent nonlinear PDEs for multidimensional option pricing. First, cross-derivative terms are eliminated by a spatial-variable transformation based on an LDLT factorization of the diffusion matrix. It is then shown that multi-asset option valuation up to four dimensions can be computed with a modified shape-parameter algorithm. Several three-asset and four-asset experiments demonstrate that the proposed method agrees well with the literature and could be considerably more accurate when the shape parameter is selected carefully.
